item.title: New Canaan Animal Shelter Offline After Fire on Friday
item.description: New Canaan’s animal shelter is out-of-use following a fire last week, officials say. Located at the Transfer Station, the shelter building had no animals in it at the time of the fire, according to Officer Sean Godejohn, head of the New Canaan Police Department’s Animal Control section.
